claim: Transit Gateway enables customers to connect thousands of VPCs.
question: How many VPCs can a transit gateway connect?

evidence.quote: Transit Gateway enables customers to connect thousands of VPCs.

note: The quotas page gives 5,000 attachments per transit gateway by default (adjustable): transit-gateway-quota-attachments-per-gateway.

claim: For peered transit gateways, you incur data transfer charges on only one side of the peer, and data transfer charges do not apply for data sent from a peering attachment to a transit gateway.
question: Which side of a transit gateway peering pays data charges?

values.display: charges on only one side of the peer

evidence.quote: For peered Transit Gateways, you will incur data transfer charges on only one side of the peer. Data transfer charges do not apply for data sent from a peering attachment to a Transit Gateway.

claim: Transit Gateway cost elements include an hourly charge for each attached VPC, Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN, and data processing charges for each GB sent from a VPC, Direct Connect or VPN to the transit gateway.
question: What are the cost elements of Transit Gateway in the data transfer cost overview?

values.display: an hourly charge for each attached VPC

qualifiers.scope: per attachment-hour and per GB sent to the transit gateway

evidence.quote: Cost elements for Transit Gateway include an hourly charge for each attached VPC, AWS Direct Connect, or AWS Site-to-Site VPN. Data processing charges apply for each GB sent from a VPC, Direct Connect, or VPN to Transit Gateway.

claim: In general, the transit gateway has a sender pays model.
question: Who pays for traffic over a transit gateway in general?

evidence.quote: In general, the transit gateway has a sender pays model.

note: Since Flexible Cost Allocation (2025-11), a metering policy can change who pays: transit-gateway-fca-allocation-options-default-source.

claim: Inter-Region VPC peering is available globally in all commercial Regions, excluding China.
question: Where is inter-Region VPC peering available?

values.display: available globally in all commercial regions (excluding China)

evidence.quote: Inter-region VPC peering is available globally in all commercial regions (excluding China).

claim: The PrivateLink FAQ says that while VPC peering is limited to 125 VPC connections, AWS PrivateLink has virtually unlimited scale.
question: How does PrivateLink scale compared with VPC peering?

values.spoken: limited to one hundred twenty-five connections

qualifiers.scope: VPC peering connections versus PrivateLink endpoints

evidence.quote: While VPC peering is limited to 125 VPC connections, AWS PrivateLink has virtually unlimited scale.

note: Wording is the FAQ's. The peering quotas page says 50 by default, adjustable up to 125, per VPC.
